name: KMJ Performance
old_description: With hundreds of thousands of performance parts on hand, KMJ Performance is your one stop performance shop! Our showroom features a complete line of parts, and accessories on display. The experience and dedication of our sales staff is the foundation for providing phenomenal technical support.
about:
KMJ Performance operates from Story City, Iowa, where it maintains a showroom and parts counter open Monday through Friday. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

The business stocks hundreds of thousands of performance and racing parts, serving as a one-stop shop for engine components, ignition and electrical systems, heating and cooling, safety gear and seats, towing and winches, and general car and truck accessories. Its showroom displays a full line of parts and accessories from brands such as Aeroquip, Assault Racing, Auto Meter, Coleman Racing, Dominator Race, JET Performance, Joe's Racing, Jones Racing, Kluhsman Racing Components, KSE Racing Products, Outpace Racing Products, PaceSetter, Patriot Exhaust, Precision Racing Components, Rampage Products, and Scorpion Racing Products, alongside its own KMJ Performance Parts label.

KMJ Performance primarily serves the automotive racing and performance aftermarket, with a focus on dirt track racing. Its customers include racers, engine builders, and performance enthusiasts seeking components for competition and street applications. The product range covers safety harnesses, body panels, exhaust, and instrumentation, reflecting the needs of circle-track and drag-racing communities.

The company emphasizes its experienced sales staff as a key differentiator, stating that their technical support helps customers select the right parts for their applications. The combination of deep inventory, a physical showroom, and knowledgeable counter personnel positions KMJ Performance as a comprehensive source for racing and performance parts in central Iowa.
